mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-2y < 0) during the signal period, indicating a looming recession that will negate the positive earnings impulse.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, if not accompanied by a contemporaneous rise in unemployment, signals a supply-driven inflation scare that will pressure the Fed to tighten policy and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines > 0.5% in 1 month and UNRATE does not rise
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid 0.5 percentage point rise in the unemployment rate over 3 months, if accompanied by a contemporaneous decline in payroll employment, signals a labor market shock that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months and PAYEMS declines
failure_condition: Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in shock periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month rise in housing starts, if accompanied by a contemporaneous rise in consumer spending, signals a durable consumption boom that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises for 6 consecutive months and RSAFS also rises
failure_condition: Housing starts and/or consumer spending decline in the month following the signal, indicating the boom is reversing.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid 1 percentage point rise in the federal funds rate over 3 months, if not accompanied by a contemporaneous rise in inflation, signals a policy error that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 1pp in 3 months and CPIAUCSL does not rise
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or the Fed immediately reverses course and cuts rates in the following month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month decline in the unemployment rate, if accompanied by a contemporaneous rise in payroll employment, signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE declines for 6 consecutive months and PAYEMS rises
failure_condition: Unemployment rate stops declining or reverses in the month following the signal, indicating the labor market is loosening.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid 1 percentage point rise in the core CPI inflation rate over 3 months, if not accompanied by a contemporaneous rise in industrial production, signals a cost-push inflation shock that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises > 1pp in 3 months and INDPRO does not rise
failure_condition: Core CPI stops rising or declines in the month following the signal, indicating the inflation shock is transitory.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid 5 percentage point rise in the consumer sentiment index over 3 months, if accompanied by a contemporaneous rise in real consumer spending, signals a durable consumption boom that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: Consumer sentiment index rises > 5pp in 3 months and RSAFS also rises
failure_condition: Consumer sentiment index stops rising or declines in the month following the signal, indicating the consumption boom is fading.
